recipe.visualDefinition: A two-part vertical composition featuring a solid purple header block with bold, stylized typography and a lower section containing a close-up, profile-view portrait of a man against a neutral, slightly textured background.
coreVisualRelationships: The purple header occupies the top 40% of the frame.
The subject's head breaks the horizontal boundary between the purple and neutral sections.
Large display text is left-aligned within the header, while smaller tracklist text is right-aligned.
The subject's gaze is directed toward the right edge of the frame.
coreInvariants: Horizontal division of color and image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale portrait centered horizontally but anchored to the bottom edge, with the crown of the head overlapping the top color block.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold white display text in the upper left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left title, moves across to the tracklist on the right, then drops down to the subject's face and follows his gaze off-frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The neutral background around the subject provides breathing room for the dense information in the header.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Medium-saturated purple (Amethyst) used as a solid background for the top section.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White used for all primary and secondary typography for maximum legibility.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Natural skin tones and dark hair provide organic contrast to the geometric color block.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between white text and purple background; muted, naturalistic saturation in the photographic area.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Ultra-bold, condensed sans-serif with rounded outer corners.
letterConstructionRules: Squarish proportions with rounded exterior corners
characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand is a stylized, script-like contrast to the blocky letters
Horizontal bars in 'E' and 'S' are perfectly parallel
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between heavy, stylized display type and light, functional metadata type.
graphicDevices: Bullet points (circles) used as separators in the tracklist

preserve: The rounded-square aesthetic of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed structure for the display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in profile looking right, wearing a dark suit jacket and white shirt. The bottom 60% is the photo, the top 40% is a solid flat purple rectangle. The man's hair should slightly overlap the purple area.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply bold, condensed, rounded-square sans-serif text in white to the top-left purple area. Add a list of song titles in a smaller, clean sans-serif font to the top-right purple area, using white circles as separators.

verificationChecks: Is the purple block a solid, flat color?
Does the subject's head overlap the color boundary?
Is the display text ultra-bold and condensed?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not touch the edges of the frame.
Check that the purple hue is consistent and not mottled.
Verify the ampersand is more decorative than the surrounding letters.
Confirm the portrait lighting is soft and naturalistic.
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid color header + overlapping portrait + high-weight condensed sans-serif = Mid-Century Modern Album Aesthetic
